summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Jakarta EE 9 Ehcache classifier migration with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skill (Link Prefetching Strategy) operates in ui_optimization domain; candidate operates in dependency_management/build_configuration for Spring Boot 3.0 migration. Peer candidates are related Spring Boot 3.0 migration tasks but address different concerns (properties migration, security configuration, servlet downgrade). Candidate has direct support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and represents a specific, actionable capability for Ehcache dependency alignment.
